<!-- pr-reviewer: 14adbaf28012e4c3f241b20f0eef0bfe99817e98 -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

- The header names the Mark 21 / EX21 control and warns LN1W and LN2W users before the first code line. The threading comment follows the same AWT setting as the T91 or M00 block.
- I compared all eight NC goldens with upstream main line by line. In each file, three header comments replace two. Every other byte is the same. The PR body lists all eight files.

## Local results

Upstream main was `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c`. It was already an ancestor of this head.

- Quick gate: 849 steps passed. This includes the post and app builds, both library suites, and the selected integration suites.
- Clippy: passed for all targets in camcraft-post and camcraft-app.
- Light lane: 6 steps passed, including the release build.
- The full heavy lanes stay in the release gate. This P3 change requires no targeted heavy step.

| post | `sodick_comment_escape` | 1 | 0 |

## Safety checks

The header test failed with the upstream post because the Mark 21 / EX21 line was missing. It failed again with only the LN1W / LN2W warning removed. The test passed after I restored the PR post.

The review used software tests. The new comments still need a check on a physical control. The LN2W post named in the warning is in PR #4065.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
